blocks.title: Marriott Bonvoy

blocks.title: Loyalty
blocks.body: Marriott Bonvoy at Marriott Executive Apartments

blocks.title: Earn
blocks.body: Guests earn Marriott Bonvoy points on qualifying stays at Marriott Executive Apartments. Elite members may receive enhanced earn and recognition benefits per current program rules.

blocks.title: Redeem
blocks.body: Points redeem for stays across the Marriott Bonvoy portfolio, including Marriott Executive Apartments, subject to availability and current redemption charts.

blocks.title: Member
blocks.body: Base Bonvoy earn on qualifying stays; Member Rates on direct bookings; mobile check-in/key where offered. Benefits vary by hotel, rate, and market.

blocks.title: Silver Elite
blocks.body: Entry elite: enhanced earn versus Member, priority late checkout where offered, and recognition benefits per current Bonvoy rules. Confirm qualification nights/spend annually.

blocks.title: Gold Elite
blocks.body: Stronger room/upgrade preference and enhanced earn. Welcome amenities pattern and improved recognition vs Silver—delivery depends on property capability.

blocks.title: Platinum Elite
blocks.body: Upper elite: suite/room upgrade pathways and lounge access where the hotel offers a lounge. Material for suite inventory and arrival planning.

blocks.title: Titanium Elite
blocks.body: Near-top elite with elevated suite-night and upgrade economics. Model elite fulfillment cost against Bonvoy-driven demand.

blocks.title: Ambassador Elite
blocks.body: Top Bonvoy elite tier (qualification/invitation path per current Marriott Bonvoy terms). Highest service expectation—confirm published qualification before underwriting.
